117	func (n *namespaceHandler) migrateExistingProjectScopedSecrets(project *v3.Project) error {
118		backingNamespace := project.GetProjectBackingNamespace()
119		clusterName := project.Spec.ClusterName
120	
121		r, err := labels.NewRequirement(normanCreatorLabel, selection.Equals, []string{"norman"})
122		if err != nil {

124		}
125		secrets, err := n.managementSecretCache.List(backingNamespace, labels.NewSelector().Add(*r))
126		if err != nil {
127			return err
128		}
129	
130		// Remove the norman creator label, secret lifecycle annotation and secret lifecycle finalizer.
131		// The controllers handling those were removed in v2.12 https://github.com/rancher/rancher/pull/49995
132		var errs error
133		for _, s := range secrets {
134			secretCopy := s.DeepCopy()
135			delete(secretCopy.Labels, normanCreatorLabel)
136			delete(secretCopy.Annotations, oldPSSAnnotation+clusterName)
137			if i := slices.Index(secretCopy.Finalizers, oldPSSFinalizer+clusterName); i >= 0 {
138				secretCopy.Finalizers = slices.Delete(secretCopy.Finalizers, i, i+1)
139			}
140			secretCopy.Labels[ProjectScopedSecretLabel] = project.Name
141			_, err := n.managementSecretClient.Update(secretCopy)
142			errs = errors.Join(errs, err)

4. **Updated** `getProjectScopedSecretsFromNamespace` to require both `ProjectScopedSecretLabel` (= project name) and `ProjectScopedSecretClusterLabel` (= cluster name) in its selector, so returned secrets carry both labels.
